rendering: Exact authored diffuse RGBA; no premultiplication/resize. Auxiliary maps are not applied; do not double-light baked relief.
authoredIntegrationNotes: Use consistent UV scale, orientation and repeat sampling so shared ports line up; per-face UV resets can reintroduce a spotted appearance.
All three sets share edge pixels, edge relief, base material and boundary channels. Each repeats on both axes and joins any other set in its authored orientation.

Diffuse maps include restrained baked relief for the existing renderer. Unlit albedo, normal, 16-bit height and roughness maps are separate proposals for lighting support; do not double-light baked relief.
Use filtered texture sampling and mipmaps; check distant surfaces on actual hull UVs in the game renderer during future integration.
These textures do not replace the separately restricted source hull geometry. Keep historical source records accurate.
sourceBindingAuthority: Advisory source bindings are preserved in SOURCE-manifest.json; use hull-bindings.json from actual hull arrays.
